note.es: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Electricidad de uso agricola sin cargos de servicio ni reparto; precio por 100 kWh dividido entre 100. Serie mensual en dolares canadienses. Cambio de unidad hecho por Dehesa Index con aritmetica exacta, sin estimar nada.
note.en: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Farm electricity excluding service and delivery charges; the price per 100 kWh is divided by 100. Monthly series in Canadian dollars. Unit conversion done by Dehesa Index with exact arithmetic; nothing is estimated.
note.fr: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Électricité à usage agricole hors frais de service et de distribution ; le prix par 100 kWh est divisé par 100. Série mensuelle en dollars canadiens. Changement d'unité effectué par Dehesa Index en arithmétique exacte, sans rien estimer.
note.it: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Elettricità a uso agricolo senza oneri di servizio e distribuzione; il prezzo per 100 kWh è diviso per 100. Serie mensile in dollari canadesi. Cambio di unità eseguito da Dehesa Index con aritmetica esatta, senza stimare nulla.
